usedFor: Lead Rocks finds verified contact data, and “Verify Email Address” checks an address with its email verifier.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Verify Email Address” in Lead Rocks
bestTemplate.why: Each new account gets its email checked, so you learn early if an address is bad.

watchOut: “Verify Email Address” in Lead Rocks needs an email address from an earlier step.
